name: Photo Card Stack
description: Dark widget with a stack of tilted photo cards on the left and matching title and description on the right. Prev and next buttons throw the top card out and back into the stack.
contents: Index label, title and description for the active entry
behavior: Next and previous cycle through entries in a loop
Active card slides out left and settles back on top with a spring keyframe animation
Text cross-fades and slides when the entry changes
Images zoom slightly on widget hover
Shows a pulsing skeleton until mounted
editableByProps: Entries: titles, descriptions, images and card tilt
Widget size, colors, text sizes and animation duration

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the index label text or accent dot color
needsCodeEdit.where: INDEX // label with the emerald dot span
moveOutIn keyframes in the style tag
nav element with the two buttons

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Button colors and the green index dot are hardcoded
